rationale: The Init function calls getTimestampString() at L57, which invokes stub.GetTxTimestamp() and converts it to a formatted string. This timestamp is then stored in the BlacklistRootEntry.Created field (L68-L70) and written to the ledger via stub.PutState("root", newEntryBytes) at L75. Although GetTxTimestamp() is deterministic within a single endorsement, the timestamp value itself varies across transactions and endorsement rounds. When multiple endorsers execute Init with different wall-clock times (even microseconds apart), they will produce different "Created" values, causing the marshaled JSON to differ and leading to endorsement divergence on the PutState write.
